correctness.rationale: The modal induction is reconstructed explicitly. Full-function truth is partition-invariant on infinite sets; every full-function witness changes a finite tuple only by coarsening its equality partition, and the finite-collapse hypothesis realizes that coarsening by an allowed endomap. Boolean and quantifier cases are pointwise, and finite-to-one maps contain all required finite collapses.

originality.rationale: The checked 2026 source omits finite-to-one arrows and does not state the general finite-collapse-rich invariance criterion. Exact semantic searches and published-finding corpus queries found no equivalent or stronger coverage, while the existing local ledger finding concerns an unrelated modal non-elementarity obstruction.

value.rationale: The theorem gives a reusable minimal-arrow sufficiency principle, showing that even a category with only suitable finite-support endomorphisms has the full all-functions equality-modal semantics; finite-to-one classification is a substantive corollary.
